claims.quote: Hyperkinetic movements were often exacerbated by specific triggers, such as voluntary movement, intercurrent illnesses, emotion, and high ambient temperature, leading to hospital admissions

claims.quote: Most patients were resistant to drug intervention
tetrabenazine was effective in partially controlling dyskinesia for 2/7 patients

claims.object_text: expanded spectrum of early-onset epilepsy and movement disorders causally related to GNAO1 mutations
claims.quote: Our findings support the causative role of GNAO1 mutations in an expanded spectrum of early-onset epilepsy and movement disorders, frequently exacerbated by specific triggers and at times associated with self-injurious behavior
